overview_description.description:
Classtap is a lifestyle company that provides access to multiple gyms and studios with one membership and through one app. It connects members to a variety of fitness experiences including yoga, boxing, Pilates, HIIT, Spinning and more. Classtap motivates customers to lead healthy lifestyles by inspiring, introducing and connecting them to new fitness experiences. It facilitates this by partnering with gyms, studios, hotels and wellness providers and through its platform members can discover and book fitness classes and day passes to gyms. Classtap helps its partners reach new customer segments and increase their revenue by marketing and filling up their excess inventory.

The company was founded in 2020 and headquartered in Doha, Qatar.

product.name: Classtap Membership
product.description: A subscription-based membership providing credits to book fitness classes and gym sessions across multiple studios and gyms in Qatar through a mobile app.

product.name: Classtap Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app for iOS and Android that allows users to browse, book, and manage fitness classes and gym sessions across Classtap’s partner venues.

product.name: Corporate Membership Program
product.description: A program offering companies customized fitness memberships for employees, providing access to multiple gyms and classes through one platform.

product.name: Classtap Gift Cards
product.description: Gift cards that can be purchased and redeemed for fitness classes and sessions within the Classtap network.

product.name: Partner Venue Listing Service
product.description: A service enabling gyms and studios to list their classes and open spots on the Classtap platform to reach a wider audience and increase bookings.
